description: The agent must: (1) Read and parse data/raw/q3_2024_sales_raw.csv, stripping blank rows and trailing whitespace from store names. (2) Use openpyxl's Workbook/ws.append() pattern to write the cleaned data plus a computed TOTALS row into q3_sales_report.xlsx. (3) Use python-docx's Document with doc.add_heading(title, 0) (heading level 0 — the proprietary trap; wrong level = wrong style) and doc.add_paragraph() for the body text that references transaction count, top store, and revenue, saving as q3_executive_summary.docx. (4) Use python-pptx's Presentation to build at least 3 slides (title slide with 'Q3 2024 Board Review', a 'Performance Highlights' slide naming the top 3 stores by revenue, and a 'Next Steps' slide with ≥2 recommended actions), saving as q3_board_deck.pptx. (5) Place all three output files under reports/final/. The primary proprietary trap is the heading level-0 argument in add_heading — an agent relying on general knowledge typically uses level 1 or omits the level entirely, producing the wrong paragraph style.
